verses.1: Therefore, I beg you, O bondsman, to honorably fulfill the call to which you have been called.
verses.2: With utmost humility and patience, with long-suffering, they endured each other in love.
verses.3: Striving to maintain the unity of the spirit within the bond of peace.
verses.4: One body and one spirit, just as you were chosen from among those who hoped in your call.
verses.5: One Lord, one faith, one baptism.
verses.6: One God and Father of all, who is present in all things, through all things, and in everything.
verses.7: To each of us, however, was given the gift according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
verses.8: Therefore, he said: “Annabas ascended to a high place, where he gave houses to the people.”
verses.9: And what is “Anēbē”? It’s nothing other than a person who also goes down to the lower parts of the earth.
verses.10: That ascender is also the one who descends above all the heavens, in order to pay for everything.
verses.11: And he also gave those who were apostles, those who were prophets, those who were evangelists, those who were pastors and teachers.
verses.12: For the sake of the holy ones’ dedication to serving God, for the construction of the body of Christ.
verses.13: Until all things are brought into harmony with the unity of faith and knowledge about the Son of God. To become a perfect man, to reach the measure of the age required for fulfilling Christ’s mission.
verses.14: So that we no longer remain naive, being confused and perplexed by everything related to the teachings of God in the midst of human beings. In all our endeavors, we must follow the methods of divine guidance.
verses.15: In love, we truly dedicate everything to Him who is the Head, Christ.
verses.16: From this, all the body’s parts are assembled and combined together through a process of harmonious integration. This process occurs in a measured manner, with each part increasing in size gradually. This leads to the creation of a complete body, done with love and care.
verses.17: This is what I say, and I swear in the name of God. Do not let yourselves be led astray by those nations, just as their minds are filled with ignorance.
verses.18: Being destroyed by ignorance, being cut off from the life of God, because of the blindness that exists within them, due to the corruption of their hearts.
verses.19: They, having abandoned themselves, were subjected to a state of eternal impurity and sinfulness due to their own choices.
verses.20: But you have not truly understood Christ in this way.
verses.21: Whether you have heard of him and been taught about him, for it is true in Jesus.
verses.22: You should be placed in the same position as before: that is, in the role of the old man who was being corrupted by the desires of deception.
verses.23: And to renew the spirit of your mind.
verses.24: And to wear the new person who was created by God, in a manner that is just and true.
verses.25: Therefore, after putting aside the falsehoods, each person should speak the truth to those around him, knowing that they are all members of each other’s community.
verses.26: Be angry and do not sin. May the sun not shine upon you during your efforts.
verses.27: Do not give any place to the heretic.
verses.28: He who steals no longer steals; instead, he uses his own hands to do what is good, so that it can be passed on to those who deserve it.
verses.29: For no reason should any bad words come out of your mouths. But if there is anyone who is good at building things for practical purposes, then let him do so, so that others may benefit from it.
verses.30: And do not grieve the holy spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for redemption.
verses.31: All kinds of anger, resentment, hatred, crying, and slander should be removed from you, along with all kinds of evil things.
verses.32: Be useful to one another, be kind and generous, and do what God has pleased in Christ for your benefit.
